acceptedFindings.title: Study question not specified
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without a defined research question, the analysis has no clear objective, and the manuscript's claim of answering a 'prespecified study question' is unfounded.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Define the precise clinical or public-health question, including population, intervention/exposure, comparison, outcome (PICO). Update the manuscript accordingly.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Verify that manuscript.md contains a sentence ending with a question mark or a clearly labeled 'Objective' section that states a specific research question.

acceptedFindings.title: Statistical results absent from manuscript
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The manuscript reports only the sample size and contains no results of the ANOVA, such as F-statistic, p-value, or group means, making it impossible to interpret the findings.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report the ANOVA table, effect sizes, group means with standard deviations, p-value, and confidence intervals in the Results section.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that the manuscript Results section includes numeric values for the ANOVA F-statistic, p-value, and group descriptive statistics.

acceptedFindings.title: Primary ANOVA result not reported
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The manuscript claims to answer a prespecified question but the Results section only states the sample size, omitting the F-test, p-value, and group differences. This makes the report essentially empty.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Add a concise Results section reporting the F-statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, and descriptive statistics by group. Include a table or text.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Compare stats-run.json estimate for 'C(group)' with reported text.

acceptedFindings.title: Variables not defined
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The 'outcome_cont' and 'group' variables lack any description (units, possible values, clinical meaning). Readers cannot understand what was measured.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide explicit definitions for each variable, including measurement units and coding for categorical variables (e.g., group levels: 'enhanced', 'standard', 'control').
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that manuscript.md Methods: Variables includes a table or list describing each variable's meaning, type, and range.

acceptedFindings.title: Unbound exploratory analysis without pre-specification
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The analysis is not bound to a method-selection or analysis spec, so it is purely exploratory. The manuscript does not acknowledge this limitation, risking overinterpretation as confirmatory.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Either bind the analysis to a pre-specified protocol and re-run, or explicitly label the analysis as exploratory and avoid any inferential language.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that the binding.status in stats-run.json is 'bound' and refers to a valid protocol artifact, or that the manuscript explicitly uses the term 'exploratory' and cites the 'resultPosture'.

acceptedFindings.title: Cohort construction unreported
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The manuscript does not describe how the 240 records were selected, eligibility criteria, or any exclusion steps. This prevents assessment of selection bias and generalizability.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide a detailed cohort flow diagram and text describing inclusion/exclusion criteria, data source, and any filtering applied.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that the manuscript Methods: Cohort Construction section includes a description of data source, inclusion/exclusion rules, and a count of excluded records.

acceptedFindings.title: No covariate adjustment or confounder consideration
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: ANOVA compares groups on outcome_cont with no adjustment for potential confounders, even though the analysis is observational. This severely limits the usefulness of any comparison.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Identify possible confounders (e.g., demographics, baseline characteristics) and include them in an ANCOVA or regression model, or justify why none are needed.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if the model includes a list of covariates beyond the group factor. In stats-run.json, variables includes only outcome and group; no covariates.

acceptedFindings.title: Contradictory limitations statements
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The Limitations section claims 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found' and 'No estimate-like records were available for p-value/effect-size checks', yet the manuscript and stats-run.json clearly exist. These false statements undermine credibility.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Remove or correct these statements. If the limitations refer to missing external artifacts, clarify.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that the limitations are consistent with the accompanying artifacts.

acceptedFindings.title: No descriptive statistics by group
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without group means, SDs, and sample sizes, readers cannot interpret the ANOVA result or assess effect sizes.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide a table with N, mean, SD, and possibly CI per group.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Request the table; existence can be checked in output.

acceptedFindings.title: No effect size reported
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: ANOVA output includes sum of squares but no proportion of variance explained (eta-squared) or other effect size. This limits interpretation.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Compute and report eta-squared or omega-squared.

acceptedFindings.title: Unbound exploratory analysis posture not clearly communicated
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The analysis was not pre-registered or bound to a method-selection artifact, so it is exploratory. The manuscript's title and abstract imply a prespecified question, which conflicts with this posture.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Explicitly label the analysis as exploratory and unregistered in the abstract and conclusions, and adjust claim language accordingly.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that abstract and conclusion mention unbound/exploratory status.

acceptedFindings.title: No power or sample size justification
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: With a non-significant result, it is unclear if the study had adequate power to detect a clinically meaningful effect. This omission weakens any interpretation.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report a power analysis for the given sample size and effect size of interest, or explain why it was not performed.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if the manuscript mentions 'power' or 'sample size calculation' in the Methods.

acceptedFindings.title: Incomplete missing data reporting
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Complete-case analysis can bias results if missingness is not random; no information on missingness patterns or sensitivity analysis is provided.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report number and characteristics of excluded cases, and consider multiple imputation or sensitivity analysis.

acceptedFindings.title: No confidence intervals for group means
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Confidence intervals convey precision better than p-values alone.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Compute and report 95% CIs for group means or for differences, if post-hoc tests are planned.

acceptedFindings.title: Data plausibility checks not discussed
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: While diagnostics appear acceptable, the manuscript does not mention checks for outliers, distributional assumptions, or data quality, which are important for trustworthiness.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Summarize the key diagnostic checks (e.g., residuals normality, leverage, Cook's distance) in a brief paragraph in the Results or Supplement.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if the manuscript includes text about residual diagnostics or model checks.

finding.title: No literature review or context
finding.whyItMatters: An exploratory local analysis does not require extensive literature, but a brief mention of prior similar studies or expected effects would help interpretation.
finding.actionableFix: Add a short paragraph referencing any known literature on the outcome-group relationship, or state that no prior studies were found.

rejectedFindings.reason: Low-severity single-reviewer finding kept as advisory but not accepted for automatic repair.

reviewAdjudication.nextAction: Route back to protocol with review-response decisions.
